rationale: The agent authenticated the user and viewed their orders, but then submitted a return without confirming with the user before the write, violating the explicit requirement to confirm every order-changing action. It also refunded to a gift card rather than attempting/refunding to the user’s credit card as requested, and did not explain or confirm that a credit-card refund was unavailable before proceeding. Additionally, it asserted specific details (item, amount) without visible confirmation from tool outputs in the transcript. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
